experiment: GEMINI MACRO EVENT TIMING INFORMATION V1

event_universe.EMPLOYMENT: official BLS Employment Situation release timestamp; NFP is not separate
event_universe.PCE: official BEA Personal Income and Outlays/PCE release timestamp
event_universe.FOMC: official Federal Reserve monetary-policy statement/rate-decision release timestamp

feature_rules.EVENT_MINUTES_SINCE: min(minutes since most recent qualifying release, 1440) / 1440
feature_rules.event_type_flags: matching type is one only for 0 <= minutes < 240; otherwise all zero

timezone: official America/New_York release timestamp converted to UTC; GOLD CSV uses audited XM EET/EEST broker wall conversion
